title: Hands-On First Look At The New Sony ECM-W5 Wireless Microphone Kit
summary: "There are some features here that got me very excited." – Miguel Quiles shares the specs along with some tests and his overall first impressions.
body_markdown:
The new[Sony ECM-W5 Wireless Microphone system](https://electronics.sony.com/imaging/imaging-accessories/all-accessories/p/ecmw5?utm_source=AlphaUniverse&utm_medium=Web&utm_campaign=Article) provides features to support a more flexible production workflow across a wide range of shooting scenarios.


In the video below, Sony Artisan[Miguel Quiles](https://alphauniverse.com/member/#/miguel-quiles/) shares all of the specs along with some tests and his overall first impressions. “There are some features here that got me very excited,” he says, “like recording in 32bit float, as well as another feature that I’ve been waiting to see in a product like this for a long time.”
